CustomField.description: Optional datetime that opens an availability window. The formTemplate runtime blocks rendering and shows the Offline Message while now is before this value; leave blank for no start gate. Combined with Close Date this schedules a time-limited form.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The form only accepts submissions on or after this date and time. Leave it blank to make the form available immediately; it pairs with Close Date to define an availability window.
CustomField.label: Start Date
